articles.title: Robert Pattinson reportedly leads James Bond contenders
articles.summary: Reports that the star – the most high-profile of the final five contenders – has been offered favourable contract terms hint that Amazon MGM may want him as its first 007.
body: Robert Pattinson has emerged as the favourite in the race to succeed Daniel Craig as James Bond, according to a credible film-industry source.

Writing in Puck, Matthew Belloni suggests that the favourable contract terms he says have been offered to Pattinson suggest that the actor, currently in cinemas with reality-crime thriller Primetime, is studio Amazon MGM’s preferred choice for the role.

According to Belloni, while other actors on the shortlist were required to commit to four Bond films, Pattinson’s contract called for three – and offered a much larger (unspecified) fee. According to Belloni, “it suggests the studio is willing or even eager to sacrifice a bit to get a ‘name’ star to front its most important franchise”.

The casting process for the new Bond film, the 26th in the official series, has become very public in recent weeks, with industry reports suggesting that three actors – Callum Turner, Jack Lowden and Josh O’Connor – were on the producers’ shortlist, and two weeks later that two others, Pattinson and Nicholas Hoult, were also being tested.
points: Reports that the star – the most high-profile of the final five contenders – has been offered favourable contract terms hint that Amazon MGM may want him as its first 007.

articles.title: TV Academy Cancels Televerse for 2027 Emmy Season; Festival Will Return in Early 2028
articles.summary: Televerse is taking a telebreak. The Television Academy’s TV festival, which launched in 2025 and continued this year, won’t be back in 2027 — and will move to earlier in the year when it returns in 2028, the org announced Friday.
body: That now places Televerse at the start of the Emmy FYC season, as opposed to during the Phase 2 voting period.

The move also comes as the TV Academy will have its hands full in 2027: Not only is the org’s Emmy telecast moving to a new home (Amazon’s Prime Video), but it will be busy completing a merger with its New York counterpart, the National Academy of Television Arts & Sciences.

This year’s Televerse took place from Friday, Aug. 14 to Sunday, Aug. 16, 2026, at the JW Marriott at L.A. Live in downtown Los Angeles. Televerse was originally pitched as a consumer/industry hybrid event, with reunions and panels directed to TV fans, but also as the first official batch of Emmy Phase 2 campaign events for nominated shows and stars.

The timing of Televerse, however, was seen as a challenge at the networks and studios, which had to scramble to bring talent to Los Angeles during a busy production period — for shows that often film far away from Hollywood.

articles.title: ‘Pluribus’ Promotes Samba Schutte to Series Regular for Season 2
articles.summary: Samba Schutte has been upped to series regular status for “Pluribus” Season 2, Variety has learned. Schutte is known for playing Mr. Diabaté in Season 1 as a guest star. Like Rhea Seehorn’s Carol, the character is immune to the outbreak and lives a hedonistic lifestyle.
body: Along with Seehorn and Schutte, the cast also includes Karolina Wydra and Carlos-Manuel Vesga.

“Pluribus” Season 2 is currently in production. The first season debuted on Apple TV in November 2025. The series was well-received by critics and audiences upon its launch. It was one of the most nominated series at this year’s Emmy Awards, raking in 18 total nominations for its first season.

It won six Emmys for its first season, including Seehorn’s win for outstanding lead actress in a drama series. Series creator Vince Gilligan also won the Emmy for outstanding writing for a drama series. Additional wins were for outstanding picture editing for a drama series, outstanding sound mixing for a comedy or drama (one hour), outstanding original main title theme music, and outstanding production design for a narrative contemporary program (one hour or more).
“Pluribus” is produced for Apple TV by Sony Pictures Television and executive produced by Gilligan, Gordon Smith, Alison Tatlock, Diane Mercer, Jeff Frost, Jenn Carroll and Trina Siopy.

articles.title: ‘Sunset P.I.’ Sets NBC Release Date, Jake Johnson Comedy Series Drops New First-Look Photos
articles.summary: NBC has set the premiere date for its new comedy series “Sunset P.I.” The single-camera comedy will debut Monday, Feb. 8 at 8:30 pm ET/PT. Episodes will be available to stream the next day on Peacock. NBC has also released new first-look images from the series, which can be seen below.
body: “Sunset P.I.” was created by Dan Goor and Luke Del Tredici, who also serve as executive producers. Akiva Schaffer directed and executive produced the pilot. Universal Television is the studio.

“Sunset P.I.” was originally developed as part of NBC’s most recent pilot season and officially picked up to series in May. The show was seen as a strong contender for a series pickup from the jump, and was one of four new series the broadcaster ordered for the 2026-2027 season. Others include the cop drama “Line of Fire,” a reboot of “The Rockford Files” with David Boreanaz, and the multi-cam comedy “Newlyweds.”

articles.title: Catherine Zeta-Jones says US move humbled her before big break with Steven Spielberg
articles.summary: The Swansea-born star got her big break in The Mask of Zorro which cemented her place as an A-lister.
body: Catherine Zeta-Jones has said she had an ego check after moving to America in the 1990s.

The Swansea-born star had become a household name in the UK, but Hollywood quickly provided a reality check for the rising star and she was even asked by casting agents if she had any acting experience.
It was during her stint on CBS mini-series Titanic that she was seen by Steven Spielberg who suggested she go for a role in The Mask of Zorro which he was producing.
"Five days later I got the job, and three days after that, I was down there starting my sword-fighting lessons," she said.

articles.title: Police investigating David Walliams over reports alleging serious sexual offences
articles.summary: The Met Police said the allegations are separate from those reported by ITV and the Guardian earlier this week.
body: The Metropolitan Police has launched an investigation into David Walliams over reports of "alleged serious sexual offences".
It comes after ITV News and the Guardian published reports alleging that Walliams had been accused of sexual misconduct by several women.

The Met said that the allegations being investigated are separate from those reported by ITV and the Guardian, but as "part of their investigation, detectives are also proactively reviewing that reporting to establish whether there is any evidence of offences".
When those allegations were first reported, Walliams said he was "not a sexual predator" and had not "broken the law".

articles.summary: The teen pop star turned Olivier-winning actor stars as Andrew Scott’s best friend in the acclaimed Ian Charleson biopic. body: Hearing this story, another Billie – the teen pop star turned Doctor Who companion and Olivier award-winning powerhouse Billie Piper – lets out a laugh so raucous and expansive, it is as if a flock of gaily coloured birds has been released into the room, flapping and squawking in every corner. “Fuck, that’s awesome,” she says.

It is mid-morning in a London hotel suite, and the 44-year-old actor is wearing a dress with wide gold-and-silver stripes and billowing sleeves. On the other side of the door, a big three-day press junket is under way to promote her new movie – the Oscar-tipped British tearjerker Elsinore – with assorted PRs, journalists and influencers bustling back and forth along endless corridors.

She hasn’t met the real Pollock, who worked on everything from Quadrophenia and The French Lieutenant’s Woman to Mission: Impossible and Chicken Run. Pollock’s first credit, in fact, was on the trippy 1970’s mind-bender Performance, which – small world! – starred James Fox. Piper’s former father-in-law, that is, from her marriage to his son, the actor and Reclaim party leader Laurence Fox, who received 347 votes in the recent Clacton byelection.

articles.title: Man dies after being seriously injured at Edinburgh film studio
articles.summary: Emergency crews were called to reports of an incident at FirstStage in Leith.
body: A man has died after being seriously injured at a film studio in Edinburgh.
Emergency crews were called to FirstStage studio in Leith at about 15:00 on Thursday.
The man, who has not been named, was pronounced dead a short time later.
Police Scotland said the death was not being treated as suspicious but inquiries into the circumstances were ongoing. The Health and Safety Executive said it was "aware" of the incident.

articles.title: Radio 2's Owain Wyn Evans raises almost £4m on Children In Need bike ride
articles.summary: Owain Wyn Evans cycled almost 400 miles, setting off from Glasgow and finishing in Cardiff.
body: Presenter Owain Wyn Evans has completed his challenge of cycling through all four UK nations to raise money for BBC Children in Need.
The challenge started on 9 November in Scotland and over the next five days, Owain rode through Northern Ireland, England and Wales and raised £3,853,530 in the process.
Reflecting on his journey, he said: "This has been the hardest challenge of my life, 100%.
"I can't believe I'm here. It's overwhelming, all the love and passion and commitment people have shown."

articles.title: Darth Vader’s lightsaber, used in Star Wars movies The Empire Strikes Back and Return of the Jedi, sells for nearly $5m
articles.summary: Used in the famous ‘I am your father’ scene, the on-screen prop was originally expected to sell for a fraction of the price. Auctioneers estimated it would sell for over $1m, but on Thursday a Star Wars lightsaber used by Darth Vader in the famous “I am your father” scene from The Empire Strikes…
body: Darth Vader’s saber was one of 27 lightsaber props up for sale by Heritage Auctions in the US, including ones used by Ewan McGregor’s Obi-Wan Kenobi and Hayden Christensen’s Anakin Skywalker in Revenge of the Sith.
The movie prop, which was used in the 1980 film as well as 1983’s Return of the Jedi, sold for $4.875m at an event titled “the Ultimate Star Wars auction”.

The sale marked a world auction record for any Star Wars prop used on screen, Heritage Auctions said, and surpassed the auctioneer’s previous sale of Luke Skywalker’s lightsaber and severed hand from The Empire Strikes Back, which sold for $3.75m in July.

Items up for sale spanned the far reaches of the universe created by George Lucas, including an blaster used by Boba Fett and a Yoda puppet hand used during the character’s original appearance in The Empire Strikes Back.
